concern_summary: The functionalities that deal with selecting, managing the state of selected rows, and ensuring proper interaction feedback for row selections.
This concern addresses the computation of background colors with specified opacities, allowing for color blending effects that enhance the overall visual experience.

This concern centers on functionalities related to Money Request Reports, handling actions such as payment confirmations, visibility management, and participant determination in relation to money requests.

This concern focuses on the management and interaction of financial reports, encompassing transaction statuses, action handling, report retrieval, and categorization of transactions related to financial activity.

This concern encompasses the overall management of expense reports, including their creation, display, submission, approval, and payment processes, ensuring that various details related to expenses are handled appropriately.

The concern focuses on the logic involved in assessing the overall total of a grouped report in relation to employee approval limits, determining whether the report should be processed or forwarded based on its total.
This concern focuses on user-related checks and interactions with expense reports, ensuring that users have appropriate permissions and that all necessary data is available.
This concern deals with identifying and managing held expenses, ensuring that all financial transactions related to IOUs are properly accounted for within the system.
